 |
| Grounding files `.agro/scripts/link-providers.sh` etc. | These live under `.oh/`. |
| D4: open a PR against `mifunedev/agro:development` | This conflicts with your instruction not to push or call GitHub. |

**Why I didn't adapt it myself:** meeting D2 here would mean building a new migration command and retirement table. The plan's own decision rules that out ("reuse existing… No new abstraction or ADR is needed"), so it's a structural change that needs a new architecture decision first. The plan also asks for one bounded worker on tightly coupled code, tests and docs, so splitting it into parallel waves wouldn't help.

**Two ways forward (I recommend the first):**
1. **Smallest change that works here:** remove `.codex/skills` from `provider_links` and the help and success messages in `link-providers.sh`, and delete the tracked symlink. Then update `.oh/evals/probes/skills-vendored.sh`, `.oh/scripts/__tests__/hermes-links.test.ts`, the docs (`README.md`, `docs/oh-directory-layout.md`, `.oh/README.md`, harness-context references) and `CHANGELOG`. Codex would find skills through `.agents/skills` only, and existing checkouts would just have a stray symlink left over. Local commit only, no PR.
2. **Full D2 migration:** first run `/architect` to decide how old links get retired safely (wire `migrate.ts` into `oh`, or add init-time handling in `link-providers.sh`), then `/spec plan`, then delegate.

Tell me which one you want, or point me to the correct plan or base commit.
